unit: one support ticket, scored when it is created

schema.description: The 11 features of one ticket, as they are when the ticket is created.

team.description: The team that owns the ticket.
team.title: Team

priority.description: 1 is the most urgent, 3 the least.
priority.title: Priority

order_value.description: The order's value in dollars. Null if there is no order.
order_value.title: Order Value

customer_tenure_days.description: Days since the customer's first order. Null for a guest.
customer_tenure_days.title: Customer Tenure Days

prior_tickets_90d.description: The customer's tickets in the last 90 days.
prior_tickets_90d.title: Prior Tickets 90D

created_hour.description: The hour the ticket was created (0 to 23).
created_hour.title: Created Hour

prior_escalations_90d.description: The customer's escalations in the last 90 days.
prior_escalations_90d.title: Prior Escalations 90D

schema.title: TicketFeatures

missing_values.order_value: null when the ticket has no order; the pipeline fills the training median
missing_values.customer_tenure_days: null for a guest; the pipeline fills the training median
missing_values.other features: never null: the request is rejected

unknown_categories: allowed; scored as none of the known values; reported as a warning

output.score: 0 to 1; a higher score means a higher risk of escalation; it ranks tickets
output.flag: true if score >= threshold: send the ticket to the senior team
